description:
Join Staples' Digital Solutions team and help power the technology behind one of Staples' fastest-growing business areas, Retail Print. This team develops and supports the applications, platforms, APIs, and digital experiences that serve associates across Staples retail stores and customers across digital channels.
 Working closely with Product Management, Architecture, Engineering, and Business stakeholders, you will design, develop, and deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing full-stack solutions that drive innovation, enhance customer and associate experiences, and support business growth.
 Our culture values collaboration, continuous learning, technical excellence, and a passion for building high-quality software that delivers measurable business impact.
 Role Summary 
 The Software Engineer II is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining modern full-stack enterprise applications that support Staples' Retail Commerce and Print Solutions platforms.
 This role partners with cross-functional teams to deliver associate-facing and customer-facing web applications, backend services, and API-driven integrations using frontend technologies such as Angular and React, along with backend technologies including Java, Spring Boot, RESTful Web Services, and Microservices.
 The ideal candidate brings strong full-stack development expertise, hands-on experience building cloud-native applications, and a passion for delivering scalable, reliable, and high-performing solutions hosted in cloud platforms.
  
 What You'll Be Doing 
 Develop expertise in Staples' business processes, retail commerce platforms, and application ecosystems.
 Participate in the full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
 Design, develop, and maintain responsive, user-friendly web applications using Angular, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
 Build, enhance, and maintain scalable backend services and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful APIs.
 Design, develop, and consume RESTful Web Services to enable seamless integration across enterprise applications and third-party platforms.
 Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, and Engineering teams to deliver innovative features and enhancements.
 Develop and deploy cloud-native applications and services.
 Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to software engineering best practices, coding standards, security guidelines, and quality frameworks.
 Optimize application performance, scalability, reliability, and availability across frontend and backend platforms.
 Troubleshoot and resolve production issues while minimizing business impact.
 Contribute to CI/CD pipeline implementation, release automation, and DevOps practices.
 Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and knowledge-sharing materials.
 Support Agile development practices including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
 Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to application architecture and development practices.
  
 What You Bring to the Table 
 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
 Passion for developing high-quality software and learning emerging technologies.
 Ability to work effectively in Agile and highly collaborative team environments.
 Strong verbal and written communication skills.
 Customer-focused mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
 Commitment to software quality, maintainability, and continuous improvement.
 Ability to balance technical excellence with business priorities and execution.
 Strong attention to detail, accountability, and ownership of deliverables.
  
 What's Needed – Basic Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
 4+ years of professional experience in full-stack application development.
 4+ years of experience with frontend technologies and frameworks: Angular (v2+)
 React
 TypeScript
 JavaScript (ES6+)
 HTML5
 CSS3
 CSS frameworks such as Bootstrap and Tailwind CSS
 Responsive web design and cross-browser compatibility
 
 4+ years of backend development experience using: Java
 Spring Boot
 RESTful Web Services
 Microservices Architecture
 
 Experience designing, developing, and consuming REST APIs.
 Experience integrating applications across enterprise platforms using APIs and web services.
 Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), design patterns, and software engineering best practices.
 Experience working with relational databases such as SQL Server and MySQL.
 Experience with source control and collaboration tools such as Git.
 Experience working within Agile/Scrum development environments.
 Strong understanding of application security, scalability, performance optimization, and software development best practices.
  
 What's Needed – Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience developing and deploying applications in public cloud environments: Microsoft Azure (preferred)
 Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
 
 Experience supporting retail commerce, eCommerce, or customer-facing digital platforms.
 Experience with application integrations, API development, and enterprise service architectures.
 Experience working with large-scale enterprise applications and distributed systems.
 Knowledge of modern development tools, automated testing frameworks, DevOps methodologies, and CI/CD practices.
 Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
 Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and observability tools used in cloud-native environments.
  
 Get great perks.  
 Bonus plan and generous amount of paid time off, including one Floating Holiday each year.  
 Flexible work arrangements, including flexible work hours.  
 401(k) plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance with many more optional benefits.  
 Associate store discount and more perks, including discounts on mobile plans, movie tickets, etc.  
  
 The salary range represents the expected compensation for this role at the time of posting. The specific base pay may be influenced by a variety of factors to include the candidate's experience, skill set, education, geography, business considerations, and internal equity. In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for bonuses, or other forms of variable compensation.  
 #LI-KA1 



 
 The world of working and learning has changed. This is your opportunity to be a part of a brand transformation and growth strategy within the retail industry. Staples is helping our customers and community discover innovative products, services, and inspiration that unlock what’s possible, while empowering you to unlock your potential. Our people are the heart of our success and there has never been a better time to join us as we lead the way in a new era of working and learning.
